messages:
marta: Quick Q — what should be our canonical signals for validation vs transient vs rate-limit errors, especially for streaming endpoints? e.g., is 422 always terminal, 429 always retryable (with Retry-After), and 5xx server-only? Also: if a stream fails mid-flight due to validation, do we close with 4xx or 5xx? cc @kevin @rishi

kevin: Proposed short rules: 1) 4xx (400/401/403/422/409) => client fix, do not auto-retry. 2) 429 => client backoff, include Retry-After header and mark retryable in body. 3) 5xx => server/transient, safe to retry with exponential backoff. 4) Streaming: if error is client-caused, terminate stream with 4xx and clear error envelope; if server/transient, close stream with final 5xx frame + envelope. Use idempotency/resume tokens where possible. :+1:

rishi: One nuance — 409 in our domain is sometimes transient (concurrent update). For those cases we should return 409 + header `X-Conflict-Retryable: true` and a short retry hint. Otherwise 409 = business logic error.

priya: We should standardize a machine-readable error envelope so clients don't have to parse messages. Suggest fields: `code`, `message`, `type`, `retryable` (bool), `details`, optional `retry_after` (secs). Example envelope:```json
{"code":"rate_limit","message":"quota exceeded","type":"rate_limit","retryable":true,"retry_after":30}``` Keep human text short and use machine fields as authoritative.

deploy-bot: infra-alert: API schema v2 deployed to staging @ 2026-03-17T09:12Z — smoke tests OK.

jamie: For backward compatibility: adding `retryable` is fine since old clients ignore extra fields, but should we default it to false to be conservative? Also do we need a migration note for minor versions?

kevin: Default `retryable=false` is safest. Docs should include a mapping table of common codes -> retry guidance. We should avoid changing returned status codes for existing endpoints in patch/minor releases; treat any change as a breaking behavior unless we add an explicit feature flag. Add a compatibility test in CI.

marta: OK I'll open a docs PR with the mapping table and a runtime PR that: injects `Retry-After` for 429s, adds `X-Conflict-Retryable` when set by service logic, and emits the standard error envelope on stream close. Will tag reviewers and link to the staging deployment. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

kevin: One more: for streaming resumptions let's include a `stream_id` + `last_event_id` in the envelope so clients can resume where possible.

marta: Good call, adding that to the PR checklist.
